description: Set hours, minutes and seconds — or tap a preset like the 25-minute Pomodoro — and get a countdown with a progress bar and a beep alarm when time is up.

faqs.a: The countdown is timestamp-based, so it stays accurate even if the tab is in the background. The alarm sound needs the tab to be at least open; some browsers may silence audio in background tabs.
faqs.q: Will the timer keep working in a background tab?

faqs.a: Yes — the presets (1m, 5m, 10m, 25m Pomodoro) simply fill the hours, minutes and seconds inputs for you, and you can adjust them before starting.
faqs.q: Can I change a preset before starting?

faqs.a: The alarm plays a beep through your device's speakers using the Web Audio API. Keep your volume up and the tab open to hear it.
faqs.q: How does the alarm sound work?

howto: Enter hours, minutes and seconds, or tap one of the preset chips.
Use "Pause" to hold the countdown and "Start" again to resume.
Listen for the beep alarm and watch the progress bar when time runs out.
title: Timer
